entities.name: Demián González
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Demián González is an Argentine male volleyball player. He was part of the Argentina men's national volleyball team at the 2010 FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship in Italy. He was a part of the Argentina national team that ranked fifth place at the 2016 Rio de Janeiro Olympic Games.
